$comment: The release-specific half of the converge gate (spec §12.4, template §3e 4).
EDIT THIS FILE IN EVERY RELEASE. A version match cannot detect a new static
frontend talking to an old in-memory schema: both report the new CACHE_VERSION
and conditions 1/2/3/6 all pass while the app is broken. The only thing that
catches it is asserting that a key THIS release added is in the LIVE response.
Shape: one entry per endpoint, with the keys its response must carry. Remove
a key only when the release that introduced it is two releases back. Adding a
key you did not add is worse than adding none — it hides a regression behind a
`require_deployed` defaults to true, so a run without --deployed-origin is
reported UNPROVEN rather than passing on the local half alone.
